```text
# #1865: Patch: Stinkyscape S10, Job Application
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape set, a card part. It builds on `main` behind R1420's gate, so no player meets these cards before the release, the last part of #1856.

## Scope

- **Cards**: `#112` Job Application, `#112.1` Paycheck
- **Uses, already on `main`**: #1854, #1840

The resume's evaluation is this issue's to design (the designer: "some evaluation algorithm based on the card uploaded … a little bit of RNG", every roll from the match's `Rng`); an iKwzki resume always hears back in 6. The email Easter egg is dropped (the designer's answer).

## Reading

Each card's entry is in the foundation's card-by-card brief (`docs/stinkyscape-set.md` once #1857 has merged); the designer's words are `JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`. The plan's fixes (ST8) and the designer's answers (ST9) win over the designer's words.

## Done when

- Each card's script, `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/cNNN_slug.rs` (filling the foundation's stub), returns `Vec<Effect>` built from the engine's verbs and reads state through the prelude alone (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6), with tests in the same file for its base and its Radiant behaviour and its BUILD M12 rows green.
- A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (`crates/cards/README.md`); a decision the spec does not make gets a ruling note from this issue's block (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- The cards' own rows (§8.10, §7, BUILD M12, `docs/radiant-audit.md`, the catalog entry) are corrected where the build decides otherwise, and the pull request says so.
- The set stays held by R1420's gate: no pending fragment, no golden trace moves, the shipped totals unchanged.
- The gates: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `fuzz --seeds 200`.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/docs/stinkyscape-set.md) (ST6, ST8, ST9); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy` until they merge; where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md).

Blocked by #1857

Part of #1856.
```

# Draft plan, issue #1865 (S10 Job Application #112, Paycheck #112.1)

## Found so far
- Stubs: crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c112_job_application.rs, c112_1_paycheck.rs (STUB #1857). No Stinkyscape card is built yet (all stubs), incl. #7 Heist (S09).
- Engine has staged quests (#1854): Script.stages, QuestStage/QuestStageGoal/QuestStageReward (script.rs ~1799), complete_this_quest, next_stage, open_stage(n), hear_back(HearBackArgs{turns, stage}), subsystems::completed_stage_of, quest_memory_of. Fixture `application` in crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/staged_quests.rs is Job Application's shape (template!).
- Goals: byEffect, playCosting{cost, remembered}, differentCostsInTurn{count}, damageInstance{amount}.
- Credits: gain_market_credits{amount} (R1840005). Lucky rolls: rng.lucky, lucky_on (R1438, R1440).
- Catalog rows exist: stinkyscape-112 params buffs 5/10; stinkyscape-112-1 params mana 2, draw 1, credits 20. Radiant faces print Lucky 1.
- Rows: spec/08-catalog.md:696-697, spec/07-tokens.md:123, BUILD.md:1289-1290, docs/radiant-audit.md:814-815, docs/stinkyscape-set.md:2405-2425 (brief), B29-B34 readings.
- Ruling block R1865000–R1865999 (none exist).
- Card-level named consts live in the script file (In Too Deep c090 pattern).
- Buff = upgrade/tune_once; N times = N draws (§6.3 Buff row). Tripling: 5→15→45..., cap advised.

## RNG (survey done)
- Hooks take &mut EffectContext; ~25 card scripts draw from ctx.rng in hooks (c065 Ace in the Hole :38-53, c036 CN Peptides, c053 Book of Tokens `ctx.rng.lucky(lucky, roll, |a,b| a.max(b))`). Rng: int(n), pick, chance, lucky(x, roll, better), lucky_coin. No weighted method on Rng; catalog::roll_weighted returns def-id strings (not usable).
- lucky = ctx.live_self().map_or(0, |me| lucky_on(&*ctx.state, me)) + luck_of(&*ctx.state, ctx.controller).
- So hear-back roll: in the QuestCompleted trigger hook, turns = ctx.rng.lucky(lucky, weighted-pick, |a,b| a.min(b)); hear_back(HearBackArgs{turns, stage: None}). No engine change.
- Paycheck gamble: ctx.rng.lucky(lucky, |rng| rng.int(39) < 18, |a,b| a||b).
- Steps: choose_from_hand(ChooseFromHandArgs{step,...}) + Script.resume IndexMap<&str, Hook>; resume hook reads ctx.targets / {of:"chosen"} (In Too Deep c090 DISCARD_STEP).

## Design decisions so far
- Resume PUBLIC once sent (held cards are in no zone; view_for::may_read returns true for a card found nowhere; Held event then names it) -> no AI redact work. Ruling R1865000.
- Engine: reuse state.held (HeldCard) + new fate field (exile instead of summon on holder leaving); new verbs set aside hand card + return held to hand (cost override 0 then N Buffs). Ruling.
- Evaluation table in card file consts (merit = rarity rank + min(cost,4) + radiant bonus; 3 weight tiers over waits 2..6; iKwzki stinkyscape-110 always 6, no draw). Lucky keeps min. Ruling R1865001.
- Tripling: memory key factor, x3 per reapply, cap REWARD_FACTOR_CAP = 9 (card file const). Ruling.
- Paycheck per start of controller's turn while hired (memory key), count = factor. R78 resets on leaving.

## Survey 1 (verbs) done
- holdBeneath field only (hold.rs:71 acts_on_field guard); release_held (card_on_card.rs:34) summons, exiles only w/o zone. find_instance never sees state.held.
- Hand pick on Activate: TargetDecl::hand(1,1, json!({..})) (Fusion Lab c031 :28-50), read via instance_of(ctx, &json_as(json!({"of":"chosen"}))) (InfiniScepter c007:60).
- Buff N times = upgrade(TuneArgs{target|instance_id, times}) tune.rs:922 (Joon Jorker c061:36 by instanceId). Set cost override FIRST so no Buff wasted on cost (tune.rs:219-238).
- draw::add_to_hand(sink, &mut card) -> AddToHandOutcome (owner's hand, burns when full). add_to_hand.rs apply_cost_riders private.
- zones::cease_to_exist, reset_instance (R78), reset_price (R766), exile_to_pile, stays::exit_mark.
- playCosting reads raw card.memory[key] number (no part key) -> remember RESUME_COST_KEY as number.

## Engine change shape (decided)
- state.rs HeldCard: + `exile_on_release: Option<bool>` (serde default skip none; ts optional type "true"), regenerates apps/web/src/wire/generated/HeldCard.ts (commit it).
- hold.rs: + SetAsideArgs{target}, set_aside_from_hand(); + ReturnSetAsideArgs{cost_override, upgrades}, return_set_aside(). hold_beneath push gets exile_on_release: None.
- card_on_card.rs release_held: entry.exile_on_release==Some(true) -> zones::exile_to_pile, no summon.
- Engine tests in crates/engine/tests/rules/staged_quests.rs, fixture card `resume_desk` (sq-resume-desk, index 18569) in fixtures/staged_quests.rs.
- No-resume case (Tylannt completes stage 1): weakest tier, nothing returned, Interview cost 0. Clear RESUME keys on return.

## Open engine gaps (pending survey)
- Set a HAND card aside kept by the card; return it to hand buffed N times at costOverride 0; exile it if holder leaves first. holdBeneath is field-only and re-summons.
- Random wait 2..6 weighted by cost & rarity with Lucky keep-shorter: hear_back takes fixed turns.
- Field Spell Death -> resummon from graveyard into own zone.
- Start-of-turn Paycheck while accepted.
